schools.notes: The Common Data Set does not provide a GPA distribution for first-time, first-year enrolled students; all GPA percentages and counts are 0%. The Early Decision plan exists but counts of applicants and admits were not provided. There is no Early Action plan.

The Common Data Set for Wake Forest University does not report GPA distribution data in Section C9. For Section C21, the institution indicates it offers Early Decision and Early Action plans, but no numeric data for applications or admissions is provided.
University of Pittsburgh does not report high school GPA distribution and does not offer Early Decision or Early Action plans for Fall 2024.
No GPA distribution table or detailed early decision/early action numeric data found in the provided CDS text for University of Connecticut.
No detailed GPA distribution data reported (C9). Early Decision applicant count given but admits/enroll data incomplete or missing in the provided text. No Early Action data present.
